candidateObjective: 外壁際の段差水切りを、シングル材の段ごとに施工する手順を伝える。
candidateFocus: ～ごとに marks each shingle course. ～の下に and ～に沿って identify placement, while ～てから orders checking each piece before the next course.

archivedSpeaking.opening: 各段のシングル材の下に段差水切りを入れます。一段につき一枚取り付け、重なり方を見せてください。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Ask the installer to describe the sidewall flashing sequence.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the current source sequence: crew at the sidewall; roof meets wall; foreman asks installers for step-flashing sequence; installers state step flashing under each shingle course; source then gives one piece per course, bending against wall and showing overlap; foreman checks each piece before placing the next course. Source does not identify a product, wall assembly or overlap geometry, so implementation commands need qualified roofing/manufacturer review. Archived Japanese changes the source card-10 fragment into an imperative, and its sidewall/location and shingle-course terms need review. Current curriculum has no authored verb-example list; archived forms remain conditional evidence. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.

cards.reviewNote: Confirm 段差水切り denotes discrete step-flashing pieces at the roof-to-wall joint, not generic flashing or drip edge; pair with the source's wall detail.
Source shingle course / hilera de tejas is one installed row. Archived シングル材の段 may read as material stage; settle trade term and shingle material scope.
Source sidewall / pared lateral names the wall where roof and wall meet. Archived 外壁際 means the area beside the exterior wall; confirm whether this row should name the wall or location.
Source flashing is generic here, while step flashing is specific in card 1. Confirm 水切り板金 and 段差水切り senses and dictionary disambiguation.

cards.sourceSpanish: Tapajuntas escalonado debajo de cada hilera.
cards.sourceEnglish: Step flashing under each shingle course.
cards.archivedJapanese: 各段のシングル材の下に段差水切りを入れてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Step flashing under each shingle course.
cards.reviewNote: Source is a fragment, 'Step flashing under each shingle course.' Archived Japanese turns it into a scored imperative and adds put/place. Preserve fragment versus command until source objective and approved detail are settled.

cards.sourceSpanish: Instalen una pieza por cada hilera.
cards.archivedJapanese: 一段につき一枚取り付けてください。
cards.reviewNote: One piece per course is a source instruction within this wall detail, not a universal product rule. Confirm actual step-flashing piece and course sequence before scored command.

cards.sourceSpanish: Doblen el tapajuntas contra la pared.
cards.sourceEnglish: Bend the flashing against the wall.
cards.archivedJapanese: 水切り板金を壁に沿って曲げてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Bend the flashing against the wall.
cards.reviewNote: Bending flashing against the wall is product/detail-specific and may conflict with the approved wall interface; hold this installation command for qualified roofing/manufacturer review.

cards.sourceSpanish: Expliquen la secuencia del tapajuntas de la pared lateral.
cards.archivedJapanese: 外壁際の水切り板金の施工順序を説明してください。
cards.reviewNote: Archived 外壁際 refers to location whereas source sidewall can name wall; coordinate with card 4 before scored sequence prompt.

cards.sourceSpanish: Muéstrenme cómo se traslapa el tapajuntas.
cards.sourceEnglish: Show me how the flashing overlaps.
cards.archivedJapanese: 水切り板金がどのように重なるか見せてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Show me how the flashing overlaps.
cards.reviewNote: How flashing overlaps depends on the approved wall/roof detail; retain the source as a request to show, not a prescribed overlap geometry.

reader.sourceSpanish: Hoy la cuadrilla trabaja en la pared lateral de la casa.
reader.sourceEnglish: Today the crew is working on the sidewall of the house.
reader.archivedJapanese: 今日、作業班は家の外壁際で作業しています。
reader.archivedEnglish: Today the crew is working on the sidewall of the house.
reader.reviewNote: Source says crew works on the sidewall, not merely nearby; coordinate the sidewall/location distinction with cards 4 and 13.

reader.sourceSpanish: Aquí el techo se une con la pared.
reader.sourceEnglish: Here the roof meets the wall.
reader.candidateJapanese: ここでは屋根が壁に接しています。
reader.archivedJapanese: ここでは屋根が壁に接しています。
reader.archivedEnglish: Here the roof meets the wall.

reader.sourceSpanish: El capataz les pide a los instaladores: Expliquen la secuencia del tapajuntas de la pared lateral.
reader.sourceEnglish: The foreman asks the installers: Explain the sidewall flashing sequence.
reader.archivedJapanese: 職長は施工担当者に「外壁際の水切り板金の施工順序を説明してください」と尋ねます。
reader.archivedEnglish: The foreman asks the installers: Explain the sidewall flashing sequence.
reader.reviewNote: The foreman asks installers to describe the sidewall flashing sequence. Archived Japanese uses one installer/担当者 later; keep speaker number and addressee coherent.

reader.sourceSpanish: Ellos responden: tapajuntas escalonado debajo de cada hilera.
reader.sourceEnglish: They answer: step flashing under each course.
reader.archivedJapanese: 担当者は「各段のシングル材の下に段差水切りを入れます」と答えます。
reader.archivedEnglish: They answer: step flashing under each course.
reader.reviewNote: Source answer is a fragment about step flashing under each course. Archived Japanese is a declarative answer; confirm sidewall detail and distinguish from card 10's added imperative.

reader.sourceSpanish: Instalen una pieza por cada hilera.
reader.archivedJapanese: 一段につき一枚取り付けてください。
reader.reviewNote: One step-flashing piece per course is a product/detail-specific installation instruction; qualify before learner-facing scored text or audio.

reader.sourceSpanish: Doblen el tapajuntas contra la pared.
reader.sourceEnglish: Bend the flashing against the wall.
reader.archivedJapanese: 水切り板金を壁に沿って曲げてください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Bend the flashing against the wall.
reader.reviewNote: Bending flashing against the wall is a technical command requiring approved wall/roof product detail and manufacturer review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Muéstrenme cómo se traslapa el tapajuntas.
reader.sourceEnglish: Show me how the flashing overlaps.
reader.archivedJapanese: 水切り板金がどのように重なるか見せてください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Show me how the flashing overlaps.
reader.reviewNote: Overlap geometry is not supplied by source; keep a request to show how pieces overlap rather than imply a generic approved pattern.

reader.sourceSpanish: El capataz revisa cada pieza antes de colocar la siguiente hilera de tejas.
reader.sourceEnglish: The foreman checks each piece before placing the next course of shingles.
reader.archivedJapanese: 職長は次の段のシングル材を敷く前に、一枚ずつ確認します。
reader.archivedEnglish: The foreman checks each piece before placing the next course of shingles.
reader.reviewNote: The foreman checks each piece before the next shingle course. Coordinate actual course terminology, sequence and step-flashing inspection scope.
